warmups.name: Arm Circles
warmups.precautions: Stand tall, arms out at shoulder height;Shoulders down away from ears;Start tiny circles, grow them gradually
warmups.cues: Arms out, small circles;Slowly make circles bigger

warmups.name: Kettlebell Halo
warmups.precautions: Feet hip-width, glutes squeezed, ribs down;Bell circles close around head - elbows in;Head and torso completely still - only arms move
warmups.cues: Ribs down, glutes tight;Circle bell slowly around head;Keep elbows close

warmups.name: Scap Push-up
warmups.precautions: Body in one straight line head-to-heels - hips not sagging or piked (unless Pike);Hands under shoulders, fingers spread;Head neutral - look at floor, not forward
warmups.cues: Body in one straight line;Hands under shoulders;Lower with control, press up

exercises.name: Shoulder Press Machine
exercises.precautions: Feet hip-width, glutes squeezed, ribs down;Wrists straight over elbows as you press;Head moves slightly back then through - no shrugging to ears;Lower to shoulder height with control
exercises.cues: Ribs down, glutes tight;Press straight overhead;Lower slowly to shoulder height

exercises.name: Single-Arm KB Press
exercises.precautions: Feet hip-width, glutes squeezed, ribs down;Wrists straight over elbows as you press;Head moves slightly back then through - no shrugging to ears;Lower to shoulder height with control
exercises.cues: Ribs down, glutes tight;Press straight overhead;Lower slowly to shoulder height

exercises.name: DB Lateral Raise
exercises.precautions: Stand tall, slight bend in elbows that stays fixed;Shoulders down away from ears the whole time;Lift only to shoulder height - thumbs level or slightly down;No swinging from hips - torso completely still
exercises.cues: Slight bend in elbows;Lift to shoulder height only;Lower slowly, no swinging

exercises.name: Reverse Pec Deck
exercises.precautions: Back flat on pad, chest tall;Soft bend in elbows that stays fixed;Shoulders down and back - not rolled forward;Move from the shoulder joint only
exercises.cues: Chest tall, soft elbows;Open arms wide with control;Squeeze shoulder blades together

exercises.name: Pike Push-up
exercises.precautions: Body in one straight line head-to-heels - hips not sagging or piked (unless Pike);Hands under shoulders, fingers spread;Head neutral - look at floor, not forward;Only arms bend - torso stays rigid like a plank
exercises.cues: Hips high, head between arms;Bend elbows, head toward floor;Press floor away to straighten

exercises.name: DB Shoulder Press
exercises.precautions: Feet hip-width, glutes squeezed, ribs down;Wrists straight over elbows as you press;Elbows slightly in front of body - not flared wide;Head neutral - no shrugging shoulders to ears
exercises.cues: Press dumbbells straight up;Lower slowly to shoulder height;Keep ribs down the whole time

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise
exercises.precautions: Stand tall beside the cable, shoulders down away from ears;Slight bend in elbow that stays fixed;Arm stays in line with body - slightly in front;No swinging from hips - torso completely still
exercises.cues: Pulleys at hand height to start;Lift to shoulder height only;Lower slowly - feel the side shoulder

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.precautions: Stand tall facing cable, chest up;Elbows high - point them back and out, not down;Rope ends near ears - thumbs toward you at the end;Back stays flat, no leaning/swinging from body
exercises.cues: Set pulley at face height;Pull rope to forehead;Squeeze shoulder blades at the end

exercises.name: Shoulder Rolls
exercises.precautions: Stand or sit tall, arms relaxed at your sides;Roll both shoulders together in big slow circles;Keep your neck long - ears away from shoulders;Shrink the circle if anything pinches
exercises.cues: Shoulders up, back, and down;Big slow circles;Reverse direction halfway

exercises.name: Alternate Arm Swings
exercises.precautions: Hinge at the hips with a flat back, knees soft;Light dumbbells only - this is a fast swing, not a lift;Alternate arms like a pendulum, torso stays still;Keep the neck neutral, eyes down
exercises.cues: Hinge, back flat;Swing arms alternately;Torso stays quiet

exercises.name: DB Reverse Fly
exercises.precautions: Hinge forward, back flat, soft knees;Slight bend in the elbows stays fixed;Open arms wide until shoulder-blade height - no higher;Squeeze shoulder blades, lower slowly
exercises.cues: Hinge with a flat back;Open wide like wings;Squeeze blades, lower slow

exercises.name: DB Overhead Raise
exercises.precautions: Stand tall, ribs down, glutes squeezed;Raise both light dumbbells in front, up overhead;Never swing or arch your back to get them up;Lower with control to thigh level
exercises.cues: Stand tall and brace;Raise in front to overhead;Lower slowly

exercises.name: Around the World
exercises.precautions: Light dumbbells circle the head in one smooth loop;Keep elbows softly bent and ribs down;Move slowly - no momentum swinging the weights;Stop if shoulders pinch
exercises.cues: Circle weights around your head;Smooth and slow;Switch direction halfway

exercises.name: Arm Swings
exercises.precautions: Swing arms across the chest and open wide, alternating which arm is on top;Keep the torso facing forward - rotation comes from the shoulders;Gradually grow the swing, never force it;Stay relaxed through the neck
exercises.cues: Hug, then open wide;Alternate top arm;Smooth growing swings

exercises.name: Shoulder Swings (Stick)
exercises.precautions: Hold a stick or towel wide - wider is easier;Move in a slow arc over and behind the head only as far as comfortable;Keep ribs down, no back arching;Never force through a pinch
exercises.cues: Wide grip on the stick;Slow arc over and back;Only comfortable range

exercises.name: Shoulder External Rotation
exercises.precautions: Seated tall, elbows bent 90 and tucked at your sides;Rotate forearms outward like opening a gate;Elbows stay glued to your ribs;Move slowly, squeeze at the end range
exercises.cues: Elbows tucked, bent 90;Open forearms outward;Slow and controlled

exercises.name: Overhead Reach
exercises.precautions: Stand tall and reach both arms overhead;Rise onto your toes if comfortable;Keep ribs down - reach tall, don't arch back;Lower slowly and breathe
exercises.cues: Reach tall overhead;Ribs stay down;Slow lower

exercises.name: DB Clean & Press
exercises.precautions: Hinge, then pull the dumbbells up close to your body;Catch them at shoulder height with a soft dip;Press overhead by driving with the legs and bracing your middle;Lower to shoulders, then to the hang, under control
exercises.cues: Pull close, catch soft;Drive and press;Lower in two steps

exercises.name: Devil's Press
exercises.precautions: Burpee with hands on the dumbbells - weights must not roll;Jump or step feet back, chest down between the weights;As you stand, swing the dumbbells straight overhead in one motion;Start light - this is an advanced conditioning move
exercises.cues: Down like a burpee;Stand and swing overhead;Smooth, powerful rhythm

exercises.name: DB Hang Clean
exercises.precautions: Start with dumbbells hanging at thigh level, slight hinge;Explode through the hips and shrug, pulling weights close;Catch at shoulder height with a soft quarter-dip;Stand fully before the next rep
exercises.cues: Hinge, explode, shrug;Catch soft at shoulders;Stand tall, reset

exercises.name: DB Push Press
exercises.precautions: Dumbbells at shoulder height, stand tall;Dip a few inches at the knees, then drive up hard;Press the weights overhead as the legs extend;Lower back to shoulders with control
exercises.cues: Dip and drive;Press as legs extend;Lock out tall

exercises.name: DB Snatch
exercises.precautions: One dumbbell between your feet, hinge with a flat back;Pull it up in one motion, keeping it close to your body;Punch your hand through and lock it out overhead;Lower to the shoulder, then the floor, with control
exercises.cues: Hinge, pull close;Punch to lockout overhead;Lower in control

exercises.name: DB Thruster
exercises.precautions: Dumbbells racked at shoulders;Squat to full depth, chest tall;As you stand, press the weights overhead in the same motion;Lower back to shoulders before the next squat
exercises.cues: Squat deep;Stand and press together;Reset at the shoulders

exercises.name: Overhead Press with Alternating Leg Lift
exercises.precautions: Press light dumbbells overhead;While holding tall, lift one straight leg out to the front or side, alternating;Keep ribs down - the balance challenge is the point;Set the weights down if you start wobbling hard
exercises.cues: Press and hold tall;Lift one leg, then the other;Ribs stay down

exercises.name: Wall Handstand Transition
exercises.precautions: Advanced skill - only attempt with a clear wall space and a soft floor;Kick up gently, heels to the wall;Keep arms locked and push the floor away;Come down one foot at a time, under control
exercises.cues: Kick up softly to the wall;Push tall through the hands;Lower one foot at a time

exercises.name: Air Punches
exercises.precautions: Extend the arm fully but never snap the elbow locked;Punch at shoulder height, rotating slightly through the hips;Keep shoulders down, away from your ears;Wrists straight, fists loose
exercises.cues: Alternate punches at shoulder height;Turn the hips a little with each punch;Breathe out on each punch

exercises.name: Frog Hold
exercises.precautions: Advanced balance hold - practise near a wall or on a soft surface;Wrists warm, hands flat, fingers spread wide;Lean forward slowly until your feet lighten - never lurch;Come out by tipping back gently, not collapsing
exercises.cues: Hands flat, elbows bent as shelves for your knees;Lean forward slowly;Hold, breathing steadily

exercises.name: Headstand Push-Up
exercises.precautions: Advanced - only with a wall behind you and a padded surface;Build a tripod base: head and both hands, neck neutral;Press only through a pain-free range;Come down the moment your form breaks
exercises.cues: Tripod base against the wall;Lower with control;Press the floor away

exercises.name: Kettlebell Clean and Press
exercises.precautions: Clean the bell to the rack without banging your forearm;Keep your wrist straight, bell resting on the forearm;Press straight up with ribs down and glutes tight;Lower to the rack, then hinge it down with a flat back
exercises.cues: Hike the bell, clean to the rack softly;Press tall overhead;Reverse with control

exercises.name: Resistance Band Overhead Press
exercises.precautions: Stand on the band, feet hip-width, core braced;Press straight up without arching your back;Keep wrists straight and elbows slightly forward;Inspect the band before every set
exercises.cues: Band under feet, hands at shoulders;Press tall overhead;Lower with control

exercises.name: Tuck Back Lever Hold
exercises.precautions: Advanced gymnastic hold - the bar must be fully secure;Start from an inverted hang with knees tucked tight;Lower only as far as you can with a flat back;Exit by pulling back up or lowering your feet - never drop
exercises.cues: Hang, tuck your knees to your chest;Lean back slowly;Hold briefly, return safely

exercises.name: Wall Handstand Hold
exercises.precautions: Practise against a clear wall with space to come down safely;Kick up gently, heels resting on the wall;Push the floor away, body in one line;Come down one foot at a time
exercises.cues: Kick up softly to the wall;Push tall through your hands;Hold steady and breathe

stretches.name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
stretches.precautions: Move gently until you feel a mild stretch - never force;Breathe slowly and relax into it - no bouncing;Keep posture tall and supported where you can
stretches.cues: Move gently to a mild stretch;Breathe slowly, never force it

stretches.name: Seated Arm Stretch
stretches.precautions: Seated tall, extend one arm and draw it across or overhead gently;Hold where you feel a mild stretch, never pain;Keep shoulders down away from ears;Breathe into the stretch
stretches.cues: Sit tall;Draw the arm in gently;Mild stretch only
